output.summary: Most of the NRR fall is lost expansion (-12.3 of 16 pts), not churn. The price increase and Routewise are poor explanations. Locked and increase cohorts fell equally, price coding is biased by a default dropdown, and Routewise explains only 6 logos ($0.41M) and is absent from EMEA, where NRR fell the same. The implementation cut (wait 16 to 67 days, flat demand) and post-migration outages both precede the expansion drop. They are confounded and interact, so neither is yet the proven main driver. Rolling back price is harmful. A reliability freeze and permanent rehiring are premature. Run the cheap record analysis and a randomized, cancellable partner-capacity test first.
